RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the December 3, 2002/Agrahayana  12, 1924 (Saka)

(Ministries:  Civil Aviation; Finance and Company Affairs; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—20
61
NPAs of State Finance Corporations
*201. DR. ABRAR AHMED:
SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
 Will the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large
number of State Finance Corporations are
very sick and burdened with a large amount
of non-performing assets;
(b) if so,  the details thereof; and
(c) in what manner Government
proposes to rehabilitate the State Finance
Corporations and deal with their large non-
performing assets?
Exploration of oil and natural gas in
Krishna-Godawari basin
*202. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) what is the present status of
exploration of oil and natural gas in
Krishna-Godawari basin in Andhra
Pradesh by ONGC;
(b) whether any headway has been
achieved in finding oil and gas reserves in
the basin; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
International look to the airports at
metropolitan cities
†*203. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to give international look to the airports at
all the four metropolitan cities of the
country;
(b) if so, what are the short-comings in
these airports in comparison to the
international standards;
(c) what is the time-limit fixed by
Government to give an international look
to these airports; and
(d) what is the quantum of amount
Government are going to spend on each
airport for this work?
Interest on deposits
†*204. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN' :
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
 Will the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the rate of
interest on deposits in financial institutions
in the public sector has been reduced from
time to time during the last three years;

(b) if so, what has been the total
reduction in the rate of interest during the
period from March, 1999 to October, 2002;
and
(c) what were the prevalent rates of
interests on deposits in financial
institutions in the months of March, 1999
and October, 2002, respectively?
Command Area Development
Programme
*205. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
DR. T . SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
 Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether top irrigation officials from
various States met to review the progress
of the Ninth Five Year Plan and chalk out
strategies to accelerate the implementation
of the Command Area Development
Programme (CADP);
(b) if so,  what were the main points of
discussions;
(c) whether any agreement has been
reached; and
(d) if so, to what extent States have
agreed to implement the CADP projects
immediately?
Stake in Sudani oil field
*206. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India is in
the midst of buying a 25 per cent stake in
Sudani oil field;
(b) if so, the efforts so far made in this
regard;
(c) whether diplomatic efforts have
made any headway; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Preferential allotments by
companies
*207. MISS MABEL REBELLO:  Will
the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of companies which
have made preferential allotments on
private placement basis and the amount of
capital so raised by them since August,
1994 to 31st March, 1999 and since Ist
April 1999 to 30th June, 2002;
(b) the names of the companies which
have made preferential allotments on a
consideration other than cash; and
(c) the details of companies which have
made preferential allotment by swapping
of shares?
Negotiations with Iraq for oil quota
*208. SHRI KHAN GHUFRAN
ZAHIDI: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have a
proposal to send a team to urge Iraq to raise
oil quota;
(b) if so,  the details thereof;
(c) whether imports under ‘food for oil’
have been dropped; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Pipeline gas service
*209. SHRI R. KAMARAJ:  Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the increasing demand for cooking gas all

(b) whether Government are
implementing  pipeline gas service all over
the country in order to avoid delay in
supply of LPG; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Artificial filling up of ground water in
Gujarat
*210. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
sharp decline/shrinking of ground water
table in most of the districts in Gujarat
specially North Gujarat and Kutch-
Saurashtra Region;

Night landing facilities at airports
1351. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the airports where night
landing and navigation facilities are
available;
(b) the names of the airports, where
night landing and navigation facilities are
not available; and
(c) the fresh steps taken to make night
landing and navigation facilities available
at all the airports of the country?
Custodianship of cargo complex at
Hyderabad Airport
1352. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of Andhra
Pradesh has requested the Central
Government to entrust the custodianship
of the "New perishable cargo complex" at
Hyderabad Airport to AP State Trading
Corporation it being in the business of
handling Imports and Exports of Air Cargo
Complex at Hyderabad since 1986;
(b) if so, whether Government would
agree to the request;
(c) if so, by when the new perishable
cargo complex would be entrusted to AP
State Trading Corporation; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Fuel bill of Indian Airlines
1353. SHRI S.M. LAL JAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the annual fuel bill of Indian
Airlines;
(b) whether it is a fact that Indian
Airlines has asked for a reduction in import
duties and taxes on ATF;
(c) if so, what is Government's reaction
thereto;
(d) whether Government will subsidise
the fuel bill of Indian Airlines; and
(e) if so, the details of plans in this
regard?
International airport near Pune
1354. SHRI SURESH KALMADI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering any proposal to have an
International Airport at Chakan near Pune;

WIN2\SESSION\4065RS 299
299
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the progress made so far in this
regard?
Operating costs of AI and IA
1355. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Indian Airlines and Air
India have been suffering operational
losses on most of their routes as reported
in the Statesman dated 12th August, 2002;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Air India and Indian
Airlines have adopted any strategy to
eliminate such losses; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Airport at Greater Noida
†1356. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
develop an airport at Greater Noida for the
operation of national and international
flights;
(b) if so, the steps being taken by
Government in this regard; and
(c) if not, what is Government's reaction
thereto?
Vacant posts in AAI
†1357. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the posts of
Chairman, Member (Operation), Member
(P&A), Member (Finance), Member
(Engineering) are pending since long in
Airports Authority of India;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when the said vacant posts are
likely to be filled?
Phone numbers at AI office, New York
1358. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for Air India office at
New York not having 1-800 phones when
all other airlines have the facility of 1-800
numbers; and
(b) whether Government will direct Air
India to provide/consider, 1-800 number
for improving the services to its customers?
Purchase of new aircrafts by Air
Sahara
1359.SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGAT RAM
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government have received
a proposal from Air Sahara for purchase
of new aircrafts from various sources;
(b) if so, what are the details thereof;
(c) whether the aircrafts proposed to be
acquired are on long-term dry lease or on
some other terms and conditions such as
purchase from Canada; and
(d) the details of the proposal submitted
by Air Sahara in this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

IA's fleet expansion plans
1360. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI GAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
of Finance has objected to the fleet
expansion plan of the Indian Airlines;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the response of the Ministry of Civil
Aviation thereto?

 MISS MABEL REBELLO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION

(a) whether it is a fact that a police sub-
inspector carrying his service pistol with
live rounds had almost boarded a Jet
